journey: A signed-in reader opens three.ws/genesis, types one sentence (or uploads a selfie), names the agent, gives it a persona and picks a voice, presses Begin, and gets back a rigged 3D agent that holds its own custodial Solana wallet, carries that persona and voice, and is animating when it arrives. The optional on-chain identity is not part of the post and is never exercised.

steps.name: the voice list Genesis offers is live
a sentence typed into /genesis (real browser, signed-in QA account) becomes a rigged GLB whose skeleton maps to every humanoid bone the walk/idle/emote clips drive
a selfie uploaded to /genesis (real browser, signed-in QA account, a generated portrait) becomes a rigged GLB whose skeleton maps to every humanoid bone the walk/idle/emote clips drive
the agent Genesis just made holds its own custodial Solana wallet (address from the wallet provision call, shown on the reveal and stored on the agent)
the persona typed into Genesis is saved as the new agent's system prompt
the voice picked in Genesis is saved on the new agent and speaks through /api/tts/speak
on arrival (the Genesis reveal) the agent's model is playing an animation clip rather than standing in its bind pose
